reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multilingual Support and Improved Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We're thrilled to announce that the build UI in Provincia now supports ten languages! This means a more inclusive experience for players around the world. Additionally, we've improved our placement feedback system to clearly indicate why a placement might fail, helping you make better decisions while building your colony. Plus, transitions between day and night are now smoother, ensuring that your gameplay remains uninterrupted. Learn more about these updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: Enhanced UI and Gameplay Features
